_note: Transparent lookup table. Every rule names its basis. The view shows 2-3 entries, never one; the first is usually an entry point; red flags always show last. No rule names a disease. Region changes wording and order, not the rule.

red_flags._note: If any matches, show footer.emergency first and the emergency department. Based on widely published emergency warning-sign lists (chest pain, stroke signs, head injury, anaphylaxis).

rules.zh: 胸部不适伴气短、出汗或压榨感，正在发生时
rules.en: Chest discomfort with shortness of breath, sweating or crushing feeling, happening now

rules.zh: 突然出现的、从未有过的剧烈头痛
一侧脸、手臂或腿突然麻木无力，说话不清
rules.en: Sudden one-sided numbness or weakness, trouble speaking

rules.basis_zh: 四肢肌肉层、与运动相关
rules.basis_en: Limb, muscle layer, linked to activity

escalate_if.zh: 伴麻木、放射或无力时加看
escalate_if.en: If with numbness, shooting or weakness, add

rules.basis_zh: 胸部反复发作，心脏相关检查已正常
rules.basis_en: Chest, recurring, cardiac tests already normal
rules.note_zh: 心脏查过正常而发作还在反复，下一扇门通常不是再查一次心脏。
rules.note_en: When cardiac tests are normal and episodes keep returning, the next door is usually not another cardiac test.

rules.basis_zh: 胸部，尚未做过心脏相关检查
rules.basis_en: Chest, no cardiac tests recorded yet

rules.basis_zh: 反复的、几十分钟内过去的全身性发作（心慌、气短、发抖、头晕）
rules.basis_en: Recurring whole-body episodes that pass within the hour (palpitations, breathlessness, shaking, dizziness)
rules.note_zh: 先排除心脏；排除后还在反复，心理/精神科和神经内科是常见的下一步。
rules.note_en: Rule out the heart first; if episodes continue after that, mental health and neurology are the usual next steps.

rules.basis_zh: 同一问题持续超过三个月
rules.basis_en: The same issue for more than three months
rules.note_zh: 持续三个月以上的疼痛，疼痛科是专门的科室。
rules.note_en: Pain lasting over three months has its own specialty.

us_notes.referral_zh: 美国多数专科需要 PCP 转诊。带上导出的那一页，PCP 可以直接转。
us_notes.referral_en: Most US specialists need a PCP referral. Bring the exported page; the PCP can refer directly.
us_notes.ppo_zh: 如果你的保险是 PPO，多数专科可以自己预约，不用转诊。
us_notes.ppo_en: On a PPO plan you can usually book specialists directly, without a referral.

cn_notes.same_trip_zh: 可以同一趟挂两个科，按上面的顺序。
cn_notes.same_trip_en: Both departments can be seen in one trip, in the order shown.
